name: shadcn-google-maps
summary: Address autocomplete component for shadcn/ui built on the Google Places API (New), with typed place results.
description: A copy-paste or CLI-installable PlacesAutocomplete component for Next.js apps. It loads the Maps JavaScript API, debounces input, fetches suggestions with AutocompleteSuggestion and resolves the selected place via fetchFields; session tokens and country restriction are supported.
contains: uses Places API (New) AutocompleteSuggestion, not the legacy widget
typed place result on selection with session-token billing
installs with shadcn CLI or copy-paste from GitHub
requires a Google Maps JavaScript API key
